"""Tests for ModuleRegistry and InMemoryModuleRegistry."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from cranioz.modules.base.module_manifest import (
    ModuleManifest,
)
from cranioz.modules.base.module_state import ModuleState
from cranioz.modules.errors import (
    ModuleAlreadyRegistered,
    ModuleNotFound,
    ModuleStillLoaded,
)
from cranioz.modules.registry.module_registry import (
    InMemoryModuleRegistry,
    ModuleRegistry,
)


def _manifest(module_id: str = "patient") -> ModuleManifest:
    return ModuleManifest(
        module_id=module_id,
        version="1.0.0",
        label_key=f"modules.{module_id}.label",
        description_key=f"modules.{module_id}.description",
        entry_point=f"cranioz.modules.builtin.{module_id}.module:Module",
        dependencies=(),
    )


@pytest.fixture
def registry() -> InMemoryModuleRegistry:
    return InMemoryModuleRegistry()


def test_registry_satisfies_protocol() -> None:
    assert isinstance(InMemoryModuleRegistry(), ModuleRegistry)


def test_new_registry_is_empty(registry: InMemoryModuleRegistry) -> None:
    assert registry.list() == ()
    assert len(registry) == 0


def test_register_then_get(registry: InMemoryModuleRegistry) -> None:
    manifest = _manifest()
    registry.register(manifest)
    assert registry.get("patient") is manifest
    assert registry.contains("patient")
    assert registry.state("patient") is ModuleState.REGISTERED


def test_register_same_manifest_is_idempotent(
    registry: InMemoryModuleRegistry,
) -> None:
    manifest = _manifest()
    registry.register(manifest)
    registry.register(manifest)
    assert len(registry) == 1


def test_register_different_manifest_raises(
    registry: InMemoryModuleRegistry,
) -> None:
    registry.register(_manifest())
    with pytest.raises(ModuleAlreadyRegistered):
        registry.register(_manifest())


def test_get_unknown_returns_none(registry: InMemoryModuleRegistry) -> None:
    assert registry.get("unknown") is None


def test_require_unknown_raises(registry: InMemoryModuleRegistry) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ModuleNotFound):
        registry.require("unknown")


def test_unregister_registered_is_ok(
    registry: InMemoryModuleRegistry,
) -> None:
    registry.register(_manifest())
    registry.unregister("patient")
    assert not registry.contains("patient")


def test_unregister_loaded_raises(registry: InMemoryModuleRegistry) -> None:
    registry.register(_manifest())
    registry.set_state("patient", ModuleState.LOADED)
    with pytest.raises(ModuleStillLoaded):
        registry.unregister("patient")


def test_unregister_active_raises(registry: InMemoryModuleRegistry) -> None:
    registry.register(_manifest())
    registry.set_state("patient", ModuleState.ACTIVE)
    with pytest.raises(ModuleStillLoaded):
        registry.unregister("patient")


def test_unregister_unknown_is_noop(
    registry: InMemoryModuleRegistry,
) -> None:
    registry.unregister("unknown")  # must not raise


def test_set_state_unknown_raises(
    registry: InMemoryModuleRegistry,
) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ModuleNotFound):
        registry.set_state("unknown", ModuleState.LOADED)


def test_state_unknown_returns_none(
    registry: InMemoryModuleRegistry,
) -> None:
    assert registry.state("unknown") is None

"""Tests for the Editor ABC."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import pytest

from cranioz.ui.editors.base_editor import Editor
from cranioz.ui.editors.editor_context import EditorContext


class ConcreteEditor(Editor):
    """Minimal concrete Editor used only in tests."""

    def __init__(self, editor_id: str = "editor.test", title: str = "Test") -> None:
        super().__init__(editor_id=editor_id, title=title)
        self.initialize_calls = 0
        self.activate_calls = 0
        self.deactivate_calls = 0
        self.dispose_calls = 0
        self._state: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def content_widget(self) -> str:
        return f"<{self.editor_id}>"

    def initialize(self, context: EditorContext) -> None:
        self.initialize_calls += 1

    def activate(self) -> None:
        self.activate_calls += 1

    def deactivate(self) -> None:
        self.deactivate_calls += 1

    def dispose(self) -> None:
        self.dispose_calls += 1

    def persistent_state(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return dict(self._state)

    def restore_state(self, state: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self._state = dict(state)


def test_editor_is_abstract() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        Editor(editor_id="x", title="X")  # type: ignore[abstract]


def test_editor_stores_id_and_title() -> None:
    editor = ConcreteEditor(editor_id="editor.a", title="Alpha")
    assert editor.editor_id == "editor.a"
    assert editor.title == "Alpha"


def test_content_widget_returns_expected_value() -> None:
    editor = ConcreteEditor(editor_id="editor.a")
    assert editor.content_widget() == "<editor.a>"


def test_default_toolbar_specs_is_empty() -> None:
    editor = ConcreteEditor()
    assert editor.toolbar_specs() == []


def test_default_persistent_state_is_empty() -> None:
    # The base class returns {} by default.
    # Our ConcreteEditor returns its own state, so test the base directly.
    class Minimal(Editor):
        def content_widget(self) -> str:
            return ""

    minimal = Minimal(editor_id="editor.min", title="Min")
    assert minimal.persistent_state() == {}


def test_restore_state_round_trip() -> None:
    editor = ConcreteEditor()
    editor.restore_state({"zoom": 2.0})
    assert editor.persistent_state() == {"zoom": 2.0}


def test_lifecycle_methods_can_be_called() -> None:
    editor = ConcreteEditor()
    ctx = EditorContext(editor_id="editor.test")
    editor.initialize(ctx)
    editor.activate()
    editor.deactivate()
    editor.dispose()
    assert editor.initialize_calls == 1
    assert editor.activate_calls == 1
    assert editor.deactivate_calls == 1
    assert editor.dispose_calls == 1

"""Tests for EditorContext."""

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses

import pytest

from cranioz.ui.editors.editor_context import EditorContext


def test_editor_context_holds_editor_id() -> None:
    ctx = EditorContext(editor_id="editor.a")
    assert ctx.editor_id == "editor.a"
    assert ctx.extras == {}


def test_editor_context_holds_extras() -> None:
    ctx = EditorContext(editor_id="editor.a", extras={"zoom": 1.5})
    assert ctx.extras["zoom"] == 1.5


def test_editor_context_is_frozen() -> None:
    ctx = EditorContext(editor_id="editor.a")
    with pytest.raises(dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError):
        ctx.editor_id = "editor.b"  # type: ignore[misc]


def test_two_editor_contexts_with_same_data_are_equal() -> None:
    a = EditorContext(editor_id="editor.a")
    b = EditorContext(editor_id="editor.a")
    assert a == b


def test_default_extras_are_not_shared_between_instances() -> None:
    a = EditorContext(editor_id="editor.a")
    b = EditorContext(editor_id="editor.b")
    # dicts created via default_factory are independent
    assert a.extras is not b.extras

"""Tests for EditorRegistry."""

# mypy: ignore-errors
# This file exercises Qt widgets and the Editor contract with type-ignore needs.

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from pytestqt.qtbot import QtBot

from cranioz.ui.editors.base_editor import Editor
from cranioz.ui.editors.builtin.test_editor import DummyEditor
from cranioz.ui.editors.editor_registry import (
    EditorRegistry,
    EditorRegistryError,
)


class OtherEditor(Editor):
    """A second concrete Editor for tests."""

    def content_widget(self) -> str:
        return self.editor_id


# ----- Registration ------------------------------------------------


def test_register_and_resolve() -> None:
    registry = EditorRegistry()
    registry.register("editor.test", DummyEditor)
    assert registry.resolve("editor.test") is DummyEditor


def test_register_idempotent_for_same_class() -> None:
    registry = EditorRegistry()
    registry.register("editor.test", DummyEditor)
    registry.register("editor.test", DummyEditor)  # no raise
    assert registry.contains("editor.test")


def test_register_different_class_for_same_id_raises() -> None:
    registry = EditorRegistry()
    registry.register("editor.test", DummyEditor)
    with pytest.raises(EditorRegistryError, match="different type"):
        registry.register("editor.test", OtherEditor)


def test_register_empty_id_raises() -> None:
    registry = EditorRegistry()
    with pytest.raises(EditorRegistryError, match="must not be empty"):
        registry.register("", DummyEditor)


# ----- Resolution and creation -------------------------------------


def test_resolve_unknown_raises_keyerror() -> None:
    registry = EditorRegistry()
    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match="not registered"):
        registry.resolve("editor.unknown")


def test_create_returns_new_instance(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    registry = EditorRegistry()
    registry.register("editor.test", DummyEditor)

    editor = registry.create("editor.test", editor_id="editor.a", title="Alpha")
    widget = editor.content_widget()
    qtbot.addWidget(widget)

    assert isinstance(editor, DummyEditor)
    assert editor.editor_id == "editor.a"
    assert editor.title == "Alpha"


def test_create_twice_returns_distinct_instances(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    registry = EditorRegistry()
    registry.register("editor.test", DummyEditor)

    a = registry.create("editor.test", editor_id="editor.a")
    b = registry.create("editor.test", editor_id="editor.b")
    qtbot.addWidget(a.content_widget())
    qtbot.addWidget(b.content_widget())

    assert a is not b


def test_create_unknown_raises_keyerror() -> None:
    registry = EditorRegistry()
    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match="not registered"):
        registry.create("editor.unknown")


# ----- Unregister and inspect --------------------------------------


def test_unregister_removes() -> None:
    registry = EditorRegistry()
    registry.register("editor.test", DummyEditor)
    registry.unregister("editor.test")
    assert not registry.contains("editor.test")


def test_unregister_unknown_is_noop() -> None:
    registry = EditorRegistry()
    registry.unregister("editor.unknown")  # no raise


def test_identifiers_in_registration_order() -> None:
    registry = EditorRegistry()
    registry.register("editor.b", DummyEditor)
    registry.register("editor.a", DummyEditor)
    assert registry.identifiers() == ("editor.b", "editor.a")


def test_contains() -> None:
    registry = EditorRegistry()
    assert not registry.contains("editor.test")
    registry.register("editor.test", DummyEditor)
    assert registry.contains("editor.test")

    assert state["editor_id"] == "editor.a"
    assert state["extras"] == {"zoom": 2.0}


def test_restore_state_is_noop() -> None:
    editor = DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a")
    editor.restore_state({"any": "thing"})


# ----- Lifecycle ---------------------------------------------------


def test_initialize_stores_context() -> None:
    editor = DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a")
    ctx = EditorContext(editor_id="editor.a")
    editor.initialize(ctx)
    assert editor.persistent_state()["editor_id"] == "editor.a"

"""Tests for HomePage."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pytestqt.qtbot import QtBot

from cranioz.application.event_bus import EventBus
from cranioz.application.flows.definition import (
    FlowDefinition,
    FlowStep,
)
from cranioz.application.project.in_memory_project_repository import (
    InMemoryProjectRepository,
)
from cranioz.application.project.project_access_policy import (
    AllowAllProjectAccessPolicy,
)
from cranioz.application.project.project_catalog import ProjectCatalog
from cranioz.application.project.project_manager import ProjectManager
from cranioz.domain.patient.value_objects.patient_id import PatientId
from cranioz.domain.project.project_id import ProjectId
from cranioz.ui.home.home_page import HomePage


def _make_page() -> tuple[HomePage, ProjectCatalog, ProjectManager]:
    repo = InMemoryProjectRepository()
    catalog = ProjectCatalog(repository=repo)
    manager = ProjectManager(
        repository=repo,
        event_bus=EventBus(),
        access_policy=AllowAllProjectAccessPolicy(),
    )
    page = HomePage(catalog=catalog)
    return page, catalog, manager


def _seed(manager: ProjectManager, project_id: str, name: str) -> None:
    manager.create_project(
        "test",
        project_id=ProjectId(project_id),
        project_name=name,
        patient_id=PatientId("pat-001"),
        patient_display_name="Gabriel Silva",
        clinical_procedure="orthognathic",
    )


def _make_flow(flow_id: str = "orthognathic") -> FlowDefinition:
    return FlowDefinition(
        flow_id=flow_id,
        name_key=f"flows.{flow_id}.name",
        version=1,
        steps=(
            FlowStep(
                step_id=f"{flow_id}_s0",
                name_key=f"flows.{flow_id}.steps.s0",
                module_id="patient",
            ),
        ),
    )


def _select_flow(page: HomePage, flow_id: str = "orthognathic") -> None:
    """Populate the FlowList with one flow and select it."""
    page._flow_list_widget().set_flows((_make_flow(flow_id),))
    page._flow_list_widget()._on_row_selected(flow_id)

# ----- Regression: deselection / search filter ---------------------


def test_start_button_disables_when_selection_cleared(
    qtbot: QtBot,
) -> None:
    """Clearing the project table selection must disable StartButton."""
    page, _, manager = _make_page()
    qtbot.addWidget(page)
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    page.refresh()

    page._project_table_widget()._table.selectRow(0)
    _select_flow(page)

    assert page._start_button_widget().isEnabled() is True

    page._project_table_widget()._table.clearSelection()

    assert page._start_button_widget().isEnabled() is False


def test_start_button_disables_when_search_filters_selected_project(
    qtbot: QtBot,
) -> None:
    """Filtering the selected project away must disable the StartButton."""
    page, _, manager = _make_page()
    qtbot.addWidget(page)
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    _seed(manager, "p-002", "Beta")
    page.refresh()

    page._project_table_widget()._table.selectRow(0)  # Alpha
    _select_flow(page)
    assert page._start_button_widget().isEnabled() is True

    page._project_table_widget()._search_edit.setText("beta")

    assert page._start_button_widget().isEnabled() is False

"""Tests for FlowList."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pytestqt.qtbot import QtBot

from cranioz.application.flows.definition import (
    FlowDefinition,
    FlowStep,
)
from cranioz.ui.home.widgets.flow_list import FlowList


def _flow(flow_id: str, steps: int = 2) -> FlowDefinition:
    return FlowDefinition(
        flow_id=flow_id,
        name_key=f"flows.{flow_id}.name",
        version=1,
        steps=tuple(
            FlowStep(
                step_id=f"{flow_id}_s{i}",
                name_key=f"flows.{flow_id}.steps.s{i}",
                module_id=f"m{i}",
            )
            for i in range(steps)
        ),
    )


def test_starts_empty(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    flow_list = FlowList()
    qtbot.addWidget(flow_list)
    assert flow_list.flow_count() == 0
    assert flow_list.selected_flow_id() is None


def test_manage_button_emits_signal(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    flow_list = FlowList()
    qtbot.addWidget(flow_list)

    with qtbot.waitSignal(
        flow_list.manage_flows_requested, timeout=1000
    ):
        flow_list._manage_button.click()


def test_set_flows_populates(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    flow_list = FlowList()
    qtbot.addWidget(flow_list)
    flow_list.set_flows((_flow("a"), _flow("b")))
    assert flow_list.flow_count() == 2


def test_selecting_flow_emits_signal(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    flow_list = FlowList()
    qtbot.addWidget(flow_list)
    flow_list.set_flows((_flow("a"),))

    with qtbot.waitSignal(flow_list.flow_selected, timeout=1000) as blocker:
        flow_list._on_row_selected("a")

    assert blocker.args[0] == "a"
    assert flow_list.selected_flow_id() == "a"


def test_deselecting_flow_emits_none(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    flow_list = FlowList()
    qtbot.addWidget(flow_list)
    flow_list.set_flows((_flow("a"),))
    flow_list._on_row_selected("a")

    with qtbot.waitSignal(flow_list.flow_selected, timeout=1000) as blocker:
        flow_list._on_row_selected(None)

    assert blocker.args[0] is None
    assert flow_list.selected_flow_id() is None


def test_set_flows_clears_selection(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    flow_list = FlowList()
    qtbot.addWidget(flow_list)
    flow_list.set_flows((_flow("a"),))
    flow_list._on_row_selected("a")
    assert flow_list.selected_flow_id() == "a"

    flow_list.set_flows((_flow("b"),))
    assert flow_list.selected_flow_id() is None


def test_selecting_a_second_flow_deselects_the_first(
    qtbot: QtBot,
) -> None:
    """Only one flow is selected at a time."""
    flow_list = FlowList()
    qtbot.addWidget(flow_list)
    flow_list.set_flows((_flow("a"), _flow("b")))

    flow_list._on_row_selected("a")
    assert flow_list._rows["a"].is_checked() is True
    assert flow_list._rows["b"].is_checked() is False

    flow_list._on_row_selected("b")
    assert flow_list._rows["a"].is_checked() is False
    assert flow_list._rows["b"].is_checked() is True
    assert flow_list.selected_flow_id() == "b"

"""Tests for FlowRow."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from PySide6.QtCore import QPointF, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QMouseEvent
from pytestqt.qtbot import QtBot

from cranioz.application.flows.definition import (
    FlowDefinition,
    FlowStep,
)
from cranioz.ui.home.widgets.flow_row import FlowRow


def _flow(flow_id: str = "f1", steps: int = 3) -> FlowDefinition:
    return FlowDefinition(
        flow_id=flow_id,
        name_key=f"flows.{flow_id}.name",
        version=1,
        steps=tuple(
            FlowStep(
                step_id=f"s{i}",
                name_key=f"flows.{flow_id}.steps.s{i}",
                module_id=f"m{i}",
            )
            for i in range(steps)
        ),
    )


def _identity(key: str) -> str:
    return key


def _click(row: FlowRow) -> None:
    """Simulate a left-button click on the row."""
    event = QMouseEvent(
        QMouseEvent.Type.MouseButtonPress,
        QPointF(5, 5),
        QPointF(5, 5),
        Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton,
        Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton,
        Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier,
    )
    row.mousePressEvent(event)


@pytest.fixture
def row(qtbot: QtBot) -> FlowRow:
    r = FlowRow(_flow(), translate=_identity)
    qtbot.addWidget(r)
    return r


def test_row_holds_flow_id(row: FlowRow) -> None:
    assert row.flow_id == "f1"


def test_row_is_not_checked_by_default(row: FlowRow) -> None:
    assert row.is_checked() is False


def test_set_checked_toggles(row: FlowRow) -> None:
    row.set_checked(True)
    assert row.is_checked() is True
    row.set_checked(False)
    assert row.is_checked() is False


def test_click_selects_emits_flow_id(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    row = FlowRow(_flow(), translate=_identity)
    qtbot.addWidget(row)

    with qtbot.waitSignal(row.selected, timeout=1000) as blocker:
        _click(row)

    assert blocker.args[0] == "f1"
    assert row.is_checked() is True


def test_click_again_deselects_emits_none(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    row = FlowRow(_flow(), translate=_identity)
    qtbot.addWidget(row)
    row.set_checked(True)

    with qtbot.waitSignal(row.selected, timeout=1000) as blocker:
        _click(row)

    assert blocker.args[0] is None
    assert row.is_checked() is False

"""Tests for ProjectTable."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pytestqt.qtbot import QtBot

from cranioz.application.event_bus import EventBus
from cranioz.application.project.in_memory_project_repository import (
    InMemoryProjectRepository,
)
from cranioz.application.project.project_access_policy import (
    AllowAllProjectAccessPolicy,
)
from cranioz.application.project.project_catalog import ProjectCatalog
from cranioz.application.project.project_manager import ProjectManager
from cranioz.domain.patient.value_objects.patient_id import PatientId
from cranioz.domain.project.project_id import ProjectId
from cranioz.ui.home.widgets.project_table import ProjectTable


def _make_catalog_and_manager() -> tuple[ProjectCatalog, ProjectManager]:
    repo = InMemoryProjectRepository()
    catalog = ProjectCatalog(repository=repo)
    manager = ProjectManager(
        repository=repo,
        event_bus=EventBus(),
        access_policy=AllowAllProjectAccessPolicy(),
    )
    return catalog, manager


def _seed(manager: ProjectManager, project_id: str, name: str) -> None:
    manager.create_project(
        "test",
        project_id=ProjectId(project_id),
        project_name=name,
        patient_id=PatientId("pat-001"),
        patient_display_name="Gabriel Silva",
        clinical_procedure="orthognathic",
    )


def test_starts_empty(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    catalog, _ = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)
    assert table.row_count() == 0


def test_lists_projects(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    catalog, manager = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    _seed(manager, "p-002", "Beta")
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)
    assert table.row_count() == 2


def test_search_filters(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    catalog, manager = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    _seed(manager, "p-002", "Beta")
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)

    table._search_edit.setText("alpha")
    assert table.row_count() == 1


def test_search_empty_shows_all(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    catalog, manager = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    _seed(manager, "p-002", "Beta")
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)

    table._search_edit.setText("")
    assert table.row_count() == 2


def test_selection_emits_signal(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    catalog, manager = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)

    with qtbot.waitSignal(table.project_selected, timeout=1000) as blocker:
        table._table.selectRow(0)

    assert blocker.args[0] == ProjectId("p-001")


def test_manage_button_emits_signal(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    """The 'Gerir projetos' button emits manage_projects_requested (no arg)."""
    catalog, _ = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)

    with qtbot.waitSignal(
        table.manage_projects_requested, timeout=1000
    ) as blocker:
        table._manage_button.click()

    # No argument: managing projects is not about a specific project.
    assert blocker.args == []


def test_manage_button_is_always_enabled(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    """The 'Gerir projetos' button does not depend on selection."""
    catalog, manager = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)

def test_refresh_reloads(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    catalog, manager = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)
    assert table.row_count() == 0

    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    table.refresh()
    assert table.row_count() == 1


# ----- Selection lifecycle (None emission) ---------------------------


def test_clearing_selection_emits_none(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    """Deselect the only row: ProjectTable must emit project_selected(None).

    Regression guard: previously _on_selection_changed only emitted
    when a row was selected, so HomePage kept a stale _selected_project_id
    and the StartButton stayed enabled after the row was deselected.
    """
    catalog, manager = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)

    table._table.selectRow(0)
    assert table.selected_project_id() == ProjectId("p-001")

    with qtbot.waitSignal(table.project_selected, timeout=1000) as blocker:
        table._table.clearSelection()

    assert blocker.args[0] is None
    assert table.selected_project_id() is None


def test_refresh_preserves_selection_when_project_still_present(
    qtbot: QtBot,
) -> None:
    """refresh() must NOT clear the selection if the same project remains."""
    catalog, manager = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    _seed(manager, "p-002", "Beta")
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)

    table._table.selectRow(0)
    assert table.selected_project_id() == ProjectId("p-001")

    table.refresh()

    assert table.selected_project_id() == ProjectId("p-001")


def test_refresh_preserves_selection_through_unchanged_search(
    qtbot: QtBot,
) -> None:
    """Selecting a row, then refreshing, emits no None to the HomePage."""
    catalog, manager = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)

    table._table.selectRow(0)

    emitted: list[object] = []
    table.project_selected.connect(emitted.append)
    table.refresh()

    # No None emitted, because the project is still in the results.
    assert None not in emitted


def test_refresh_emits_none_when_selected_project_is_filtered_out(
    qtbot: QtBot,
) -> None:
    """Search filtering the selected project away must clear HomePage state."""
    catalog, manager = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    _seed(manager, "p-002", "Beta")
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)

    table._table.selectRow(0)  # Alpha, p-001
    assert table.selected_project_id() == ProjectId("p-001")

    with qtbot.waitSignal(table.project_selected, timeout=1000) as blocker:
        table._search_edit.setText("beta")  # filters out Alpha

    assert blocker.args[0] is None
    assert table.selected_project_id() is None
    assert table.row_count() == 1


def test_populate_does_not_emit_none_when_nothing_was_selected(
    qtbot: QtBot,
) -> None:
    """An initial or repeated refresh with no prior selection must stay silent."""
    catalog, manager = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)

    emitted: list[object] = []
    table.project_selected.connect(emitted.append)
    table.refresh()

    assert emitted == []


def test_populate_blocks_intermediate_signals(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    """During repopulation, only the final selection state is emitted.

    If blockSignals() were missing, clearSelection() inside _populate
    would emit None, then selectRow() would emit the ProjectId — the
    HomePage would see a None-then-id flicker on every refresh.
    """
    catalog, manager = _make_catalog_and_manager()
    _seed(manager, "p-001", "Alpha")
    _seed(manager, "p-002", "Beta")
    table = ProjectTable(catalog)
    qtbot.addWidget(table)

    table._table.selectRow(0)  # p-001

    emitted: list[object] = []
    table.project_selected.connect(emitted.append)
    table.refresh()

    # Exactly one emission (if any), and it must be the ProjectId,
    # never a bare None.
    assert None not in emitted

"""Tests for ThemeService."""

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses

import pytest

from cranioz.ui.theme.service import ThemeName, ThemeService


def test_default_theme_is_dark() -> None:
    service = ThemeService()
    assert service.theme is ThemeName.DARK


def test_with_theme_returns_new_instance() -> None:
    service = ThemeService()
    light = service.with_theme(ThemeName.LIGHT)
    assert light is not service
    assert light.theme is ThemeName.LIGHT
    assert service.theme is ThemeName.DARK  # original unchanged


def test_with_theme_is_idempotent_for_same_theme() -> None:
    service = ThemeService(theme=ThemeName.LIGHT)
    again = service.with_theme(ThemeName.LIGHT)
    assert again == service
    assert again is not service


def test_icon_name_is_identity() -> None:
    service = ThemeService()
    assert service.icon_name("log") == "log"
    assert service.icon_name("toggle") == "toggle"


def test_icon_name_is_theme_agnostic() -> None:
    dark = ThemeService(theme=ThemeName.DARK)
    light = ThemeService(theme=ThemeName.LIGHT)
    assert dark.icon_name("x") == light.icon_name("x")


def test_empty_icon_name_raises() -> None:
    service = ThemeService()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="logical_name"):
        service.icon_name("")


def test_theme_name_members() -> None:
    expected = {"LIGHT", "DARK"}
    actual = {member.name for member in ThemeName}
    assert actual == expected


def test_theme_service_is_frozen() -> None:
    service = ThemeService()
    with pytest.raises(dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError):
        service.theme = ThemeName.LIGHT  # type: ignore[misc]

# mypy: ignore-errors
# This file intentionally mutates frozen dataclasses to test immutability.

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses

import pytest

from cranioz.ui.toolbars.item import (
    ActionItem,
    Separator,
    ToggleItem,
    ToolbarItemKind,
)

# ----- ActionItem --------------------------------------------------


def test_action_item_holds_fields() -> None:
    item = ActionItem(tool_id="tool.log", label="Log")
    assert item.tool_id == "tool.log"
    assert item.label == "Log"
    assert item.icon is None
    assert item.kind is ToolbarItemKind.ACTION


def test_action_item_with_icon() -> None:
    item = ActionItem(tool_id="tool.log", label="Log", icon="log")
    assert item.icon == "log"


def test_action_item_requires_tool_id() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="tool_id"):
        ActionItem(tool_id="", label="Log")


def test_action_item_requires_label() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="label"):
        ActionItem(tool_id="tool.log", label="")


# ----- ToggleItem --------------------------------------------------


def test_toggle_item_defaults() -> None:
    item = ToggleItem(tool_id="tool.grid", label="Grid")
    assert item.tool_id == "tool.grid"
    assert item.label == "Grid"
    assert item.icon is None
    assert item.checked is False
    assert item.kind is ToolbarItemKind.TOGGLE


def test_toggle_item_checked_true() -> None:
    item = ToggleItem(tool_id="tool.grid", label="Grid", checked=True)
    assert item.checked is True


def test_toggle_item_requires_tool_id() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="tool_id"):
        ToggleItem(tool_id="", label="Grid")


def test_toggle_item_requires_label() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="label"):
        ToggleItem(tool_id="tool.grid", label="")

    assert sep.kind is ToolbarItemKind.SEPARATOR


def test_separators_are_equal() -> None:
    assert Separator() == Separator()


# ----- Equality and immutability -----------------------------------


def test_action_items_with_same_data_are_equal() -> None:
    a = ActionItem(tool_id="tool.log", label="Log")
    b = ActionItem(tool_id="tool.log", label="Log")
    assert a == b


def test_action_items_with_different_data_are_not_equal() -> None:
    a = ActionItem(tool_id="tool.log", label="Log")
    b = ActionItem(tool_id="tool.other", label="Other")
    assert a != b


def test_action_item_is_frozen() -> None:

        item.label = "Other"


def test_toggle_item_is_frozen() -> None:

        item.checked = True


# ----- Enum --------------------------------------------------------


def test_toolbar_item_kind_members() -> None:

    actual = {member.name for member in ToolbarItemKind}

    state = ToolbarState(toolbar_id="tb.x", visible=True)
    state.visible = False
    assert state.visible is False

"""Tests for the Toolbar widget.

These tests validate that the Toolbar materializes a ToolbarSpec
against a ToolRegistry and a ThemeService, and that user interaction
produces the expected signals.
"""

# mypy: ignore-errors
# This file exercises Qt widgets and intentionally triggers edge cases.

from __future__ import annotations

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QPushButton
from pytestqt.qtbot import QtBot

from cranioz.ui.theme.service import ThemeService
from cranioz.ui.toolbars.base import Toolbar
from cranioz.ui.toolbars.specification import ToolbarOrientation
from cranioz.ui.tools.registry.tool_definition import ToolContext
from cranioz.ui.tools.registry.tool_registry import ToolRegistry

# ----- Construction --------------------------------------------------


def test_empty_toolbar_has_no_bindings(
    qtbot: QtBot,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry,
    theme_service: ThemeService,
    make_toolbar_spec,
) -> None:
    spec = make_toolbar_spec(tool_ids=())
    toolbar = Toolbar(spec, tool_registry, theme_service)
    qtbot.addWidget(toolbar)

    assert toolbar.bindings() == ()
    assert toolbar.tool_ids() == ()


def test_toolbar_with_one_tool_creates_one_binding(
    qtbot: QtBot,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry,
    theme_service: ThemeService,
    make_toolbar_spec,
) -> None:
    spec = make_toolbar_spec(tool_ids=("tool.log",))
    toolbar = Toolbar(spec, tool_registry, theme_service)
    qtbot.addWidget(toolbar)

    assert toolbar.tool_ids() == ("tool.log",)


def test_toolbar_with_two_tools_preserves_order(
    qtbot: QtBot,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry,
    theme_service: ThemeService,
    make_toolbar_spec,
) -> None:
    spec = make_toolbar_spec(tool_ids=("tool.toggle", "tool.log"))
    toolbar = Toolbar(spec, tool_registry, theme_service)
    qtbot.addWidget(toolbar)

    assert toolbar.tool_ids() == ("tool.toggle", "tool.log")


def test_toolbar_resolves_tool_instances(
    qtbot: QtBot,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry,
    theme_service: ThemeService,
    make_toolbar_spec,
) -> None:
    spec = make_toolbar_spec(tool_ids=("tool.log",))
    toolbar = Toolbar(spec, tool_registry, theme_service)
    qtbot.addWidget(toolbar)

    binding = toolbar.bindings()[0]
    assert binding.tool is not None
    assert binding.tool.identifier == "tool.log"


# ----- Orientation ---------------------------------------------------


def test_horizontal_toolbar_renders_buttons(
    qtbot: QtBot,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry,
    theme_service: ThemeService,
    make_toolbar_spec,
) -> None:
    spec = make_toolbar_spec(
        orientation=ToolbarOrientation.HORIZONTAL,
        tool_ids=("tool.log",),
    )
    toolbar = Toolbar(spec, tool_registry, theme_service)
    qtbot.addWidget(toolbar)

    buttons = toolbar.findChildren(QPushButton)
    assert len(buttons) == 1
    assert buttons[0].text() == "Log"


def test_vertical_toolbar_renders_buttons(
    qtbot: QtBot,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry,
    theme_service: ThemeService,
    make_toolbar_spec,
) -> None:
    spec = make_toolbar_spec(
        orientation=ToolbarOrientation.VERTICAL,
        tool_ids=("tool.toggle",),
    )
    toolbar = Toolbar(spec, tool_registry, theme_service)
    qtbot.addWidget(toolbar)

    buttons = toolbar.findChildren(QPushButton)
    assert len(buttons) == 1
    assert buttons[0].text() == "Toggle"


# ----- Icon resolution ----------------------------------------------


def test_toolbar_resolves_icon_name_via_theme(
    qtbot: QtBot,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry,
    theme_service: ThemeService,
    make_toolbar_spec,
) -> None:
    spec = make_toolbar_spec(tool_ids=("tool.log",))
    toolbar = Toolbar(spec, tool_registry, theme_service)
    qtbot.addWidget(toolbar)

    button = toolbar.findChild(QPushButton)
    assert button is not None
    # The button stores the resolved icon name as a dynamic property.
    # The actual icon file is not loaded in this phase.
    assert button.property("icon_name") == "log"


# ----- Signals ------------------------------------------------------


def test_clicking_action_tool_emits_signal(
    qtbot: QtBot,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry,
    theme_service: ThemeService,
    make_toolbar_spec,
) -> None:
    spec = make_toolbar_spec(tool_ids=("tool.log",))
    toolbar = Toolbar(spec, tool_registry, theme_service)
    qtbot.addWidget(toolbar)

    with qtbot.waitSignal(toolbar.tool_triggered, timeout=1000) as blocker:
        button = toolbar.findChild(QPushButton)
        assert button is not None
        button.click()

    assert blocker.args == ["tool.log"]


def test_toggling_toggle_tool_emits_signal(
    qtbot: QtBot,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry,
    theme_service: ThemeService,
    make_toolbar_spec,
) -> None:
    spec = make_toolbar_spec(tool_ids=("tool.toggle",))
    toolbar = Toolbar(spec, tool_registry, theme_service)
    qtbot.addWidget(toolbar)

    with qtbot.waitSignal(toolbar.tool_toggled, timeout=1000) as blocker:
        button = toolbar.findChild(QPushButton)
        assert button is not None
        assert button.isCheckable()
        button.click()

    tool_id, checked = blocker.args
    assert tool_id == "tool.toggle"
    assert checked is True


# ----- Interaction guards -------------------------------------------


def test_disabled_tool_does_not_emit_signal(
    qtbot: QtBot,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry,
    theme_service: ThemeService,
    make_toolbar_spec,
) -> None:
    spec = make_toolbar_spec(tool_ids=("tool.log",))
    ctx = ToolContext(extras={"enabled": False})
    toolbar = Toolbar(spec, tool_registry, theme_service, context=ctx)
    qtbot.addWidget(toolbar)

    emitted: list[str] = []
    toolbar.tool_triggered.connect(emitted.append)

    button = toolbar.findChild(QPushButton)
    assert button is not None
    button.click()

    assert emitted == []


def test_unavailable_tool_does_not_emit_signal(
    qtbot: QtBot,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry,
    theme_service: ThemeService,
    make_toolbar_spec,
) -> None:
    spec = make_toolbar_spec(tool_ids=("tool.log",))
    ctx = ToolContext(extras={"available": False})
    toolbar = Toolbar(spec, tool_registry, theme_service, context=ctx)
    qtbot.addWidget(toolbar)

    emitted: list[str] = []
    toolbar.tool_triggered.connect(emitted.append)

    button = toolbar.findChild(QPushButton)
    assert button is not None
    button.click()

    assert emitted == []


# ----- Errors -------------------------------------------------------


def test_unknown_tool_id_raises(
    qtbot: QtBot,
    tool_registry: ToolRegistry,
    theme_service: ThemeService,
    make_toolbar_spec,
) -> None:
    spec = make_toolbar_spec(tool_ids=("tool.unknown",))
    try:
        toolbar = Toolbar(spec, tool_registry, theme_service)
    except KeyError as exc:
        assert "tool.unknown" in str(exc)
    else:
        qtbot.addWidget(toolbar)
        raise AssertionError("expected KeyError for unknown tool_id")

"""Tests for the Tool Protocol and ToolContext."""

from __future__ import annotations

from cranioz.ui.tools.registry.tool_definition import ToolContext


class ConcreteTool:
    """Minimal Tool implementation used only in tests."""

    identifier = "tool.log"
    label = "Log"
    description = "Logs a message"
    icon: str | None = None
    category: str | None = None

    def is_available(self, context: ToolContext) -> bool:
        return bool(context.extras.get("available", True))

    def is_enabled(self, context: ToolContext) -> bool:
        return bool(context.extras.get("enabled", True))


def test_tool_context_defaults() -> None:
    ctx = ToolContext()
    assert ctx.extras == {}


def test_tool_context_with_extras() -> None:
    ctx = ToolContext(extras={"enabled": False})
    assert ctx.extras["enabled"] is False


def test_concrete_tool_satisfies_protocol() -> None:
    tool = ConcreteTool()
    ctx = ToolContext()

    assert tool.identifier == "tool.log"
    assert tool.label == "Log"
    assert tool.description == "Logs a message"
    assert tool.icon is None
    assert tool.category is None
    assert tool.is_available(ctx) is True
    assert tool.is_enabled(ctx) is True


def test_tool_is_available() -> None:
    tool = ConcreteTool()
    assert tool.is_available(ToolContext()) is True


def test_tool_is_available_respects_context() -> None:
    tool = ConcreteTool()
    assert tool.is_available(ToolContext(extras={"available": False})) is False


def test_tool_is_enabled_defaults_to_true() -> None:
    tool = ConcreteTool()
    assert tool.is_enabled(ToolContext()) is True


def test_tool_is_enabled_respects_context() -> None:
    tool = ConcreteTool()
    assert tool.is_enabled(ToolContext(extras={"enabled": False})) is False


def test_object_without_methods_fails_protocol() -> None:
    class NotATool:
        identifier = "not.a.tool"

    not_a_tool = NotATool()
    assert not hasattr(not_a_tool, "is_available")
    assert not hasattr(not_a_tool, "is_enabled")

FILE: tests/unit/ui/tools/registry/test_tool_registry.py

"""Tests for ToolRegistry."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from cranioz.ui.tools.builtin.log_tool import LogTool
from cranioz.ui.tools.registry.tool_registry import (
    ToolRegistry,
    ToolRegistryError,
)


def _make_log() -> LogTool:
    return LogTool()


def test_register_and_resolve() -> None:
    registry = ToolRegistry()
    registry.register("tool.log", _make_log)
    factory = registry.resolve("tool.log")
    assert factory is _make_log


def test_register_idempotent_for_same_factory() -> None:
    registry = ToolRegistry()
    registry.register("tool.log", _make_log)
    registry.register("tool.log", _make_log)  # no raise
    assert registry.contains("tool.log")


def test_register_different_factory_for_same_id_raises() -> None:
    def other_factory() -> LogTool:
        return LogTool()

    registry = ToolRegistry()
    registry.register("tool.log", _make_log)
    with pytest.raises(ToolRegistryError, match="different factory"):
        registry.register("tool.log", other_factory)


def test_register_empty_id_raises() -> None:
    registry = ToolRegistry()
    with pytest.raises(ToolRegistryError, match="must not be empty"):
        registry.register("", _make_log)


def test_resolve_unknown_raises_keyerror() -> None:
    registry = ToolRegistry()
    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match="not registered"):
        registry.resolve("tool.unknown")


def test_create_returns_new_instance_each_time() -> None:
    registry = ToolRegistry()
    registry.register("tool.log", _make_log)
    a = registry.create("tool.log")
    b = registry.create("tool.log")
    assert a is not b
    assert isinstance(a, LogTool)
    assert isinstance(b, LogTool)


def test_unregister_removes() -> None:
    registry = ToolRegistry()
    registry.register("tool.log", _make_log)
    registry.unregister("tool.log")
    assert not registry.contains("tool.log")


def test_unregister_unknown_is_noop() -> None:
    registry = ToolRegistry()
    registry.unregister("tool.unknown")  # no raise


def test_identifiers_in_registration_order() -> None:
    registry = ToolRegistry()
    registry.register("tool.b", _make_log)
    registry.register("tool.a", _make_log)
    assert registry.identifiers() == ("tool.b", "tool.a")


def test_contains() -> None:
    registry = ToolRegistry()
    assert not registry.contains("tool.log")
    registry.register("tool.log", _make_log)
    assert registry.contains("tool.log")

"""Tests for Area."""

# mypy: ignore-errors
# This file exercises Qt widgets indirectly via DummyEditor.

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from cranioz.ui.editors.builtin.test_editor import DummyEditor
from cranioz.ui.workspace.areas.area import Area, AreaError
from cranioz.ui.workspace.areas.placement import Placement


def _area(
    area_id: str = "area.central",
    title: str = "Central",
    placement: Placement = Placement.CENTRAL,
) -> Area:
    return Area(area_id=area_id, title=title, placement=placement)


# ----- Construction ------------------------------------------------


def test_area_holds_id_and_title() -> None:
    area = _area(area_id="area.central", title="Central")
    assert area.area_id == "area.central"
    assert area.title == "Central"


def test_area_holds_placement() -> None:
    area = _area(placement=Placement.RIGHT)
    assert area.placement is Placement.RIGHT


def test_area_is_visible_by_default() -> None:
    area = _area()
    assert area.visible is True


def test_empty_area_id_raises() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(AreaError, match="area_id"):
        _area(area_id="")


def test_empty_title_raises() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(AreaError, match="title"):
        _area(title="")


# ----- Visibility ---------------------------------------------------


def test_hide_and_show() -> None:
    area = _area()
    area.hide()
    assert area.visible is False
    area.show()
    assert area.visible is True


# ----- Editor management -------------------------------------------


def test_new_area_has_no_editors() -> None:
    area = _area()
    assert area.editors() == ()
    assert area.editor_count() == 0
    assert area.active_editor_id is None
    assert area.is_empty() is True


def test_add_editor_appends() -> None:
    area = _area()
    editor = DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a")
    area.add_editor(editor)
    assert area.editor_count() == 1
    assert area.get_editor("editor.a") is editor
    assert area.is_empty() is False


def test_first_editor_becomes_active() -> None:
    area = _area()
    editor = DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a")
    area.add_editor(editor)
    assert area.active_editor_id == "editor.a"
    assert area.active_editor is editor


def test_add_editor_with_duplicate_id_raises() -> None:
    area = _area()
    area.add_editor(DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a"))
    with pytest.raises(AreaError, match="already hosted"):
        area.add_editor(DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a"))


def test_remove_editor_returns_it() -> None:
    area = _area()
    editor = DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a")
    area.add_editor(editor)
    removed = area.remove_editor("editor.a")
    assert removed is editor
    assert area.editor_count() == 0
    assert area.is_empty() is True


def test_remove_unknown_editor_returns_none() -> None:
    area = _area()
    assert area.remove_editor("editor.unknown") is None


def test_removing_active_editor_promotes_next() -> None:
    area = _area()
    a = DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a")
    b = DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.b")
    area.add_editor(a)
    area.add_editor(b)
    assert area.active_editor_id == "editor.a"

    area.remove_editor("editor.a")
    assert area.active_editor_id == "editor.b"


def test_removing_last_editor_clears_active_but_keeps_area() -> None:
    area = _area()
    area.add_editor(DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a"))
    area.remove_editor("editor.a")
    assert area.active_editor_id is None
    assert area.is_empty() is True
    # The Area itself remains a valid container.
    assert area.area_id == "area.central"
    assert area.placement is Placement.CENTRAL


def test_removing_inactive_editor_keeps_active() -> None:
    area = _area()
    a = DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a")
    b = DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.b")
    area.add_editor(a)
    area.add_editor(b)
    area.remove_editor("editor.b")
    assert area.active_editor_id == "editor.a"


# ----- Active Editor -------------------------------------------------


def test_set_active_editor() -> None:
    area = _area()
    a = DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a")
    b = DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.b")
    area.add_editor(a)
    area.add_editor(b)
    area.set_active_editor("editor.b")
    assert area.active_editor_id == "editor.b"
    assert area.active_editor is b


def test_set_active_editor_unknown_raises() -> None:
    area = _area()
    with pytest.raises(AreaError, match="not hosted"):
        area.set_active_editor("editor.unknown")


# ----- Contains and count ------------------------------------------


def test_contains() -> None:
    area = _area()
    assert not area.contains("editor.a")
    area.add_editor(DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a"))
    assert area.contains("editor.a")


# ----- Representation ----------------------------------------------


def test_repr_contains_key_fields() -> None:
    area = _area()
    area.add_editor(DummyEditor(editor_id="editor.a"))
    text = repr(area)
    assert "area.central" in text
    assert "central" in text
    assert "editor.a" in text

"""Tests for AreaManager."""

# mypy: ignore-errors

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from cranioz.ui.workspace.areas.area import Area
from cranioz.ui.workspace.areas.area_manager import (
    AreaManager,
    AreaManagerError,
)
from cranioz.ui.workspace.areas.placement import Placement


def _area(
    area_id: str,
    placement: Placement = Placement.CENTRAL,
) -> Area:
    return Area(area_id=area_id, title=area_id, placement=placement)


# ----- Registration ------------------------------------------------


def test_register_and_get() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    area = _area("area.central")
    manager.register(area)
    assert manager.get("area.central") is area


def test_register_same_instance_is_idempotent() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    area = _area("area.central")
    manager.register(area)
    manager.register(area)  # no raise
    assert manager.area_count() == 1


def test_register_different_instance_same_id_raises() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    a = _area("area.central")
    b = _area("area.central")
    manager.register(a)
    with pytest.raises(AreaManagerError, match="different Area"):
        manager.register(b)


# ----- Retrieval ---------------------------------------------------


def test_get_unknown_returns_none() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    assert manager.get("area.unknown") is None


def test_require_returns_area() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    area = _area("area.central")
    manager.register(area)
    assert manager.require("area.central") is area


def test_require_unknown_raises_keyerror() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match="not registered"):
        manager.require("area.unknown")


def test_contains() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    assert not manager.contains("area.central")
    manager.register(_area("area.central"))
    assert manager.contains("area.central")


# ----- Unregister --------------------------------------------------


def test_unregister_returns_area() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    area = _area("area.central")
    manager.register(area)
    removed = manager.unregister("area.central")
    assert removed is area
    assert not manager.contains("area.central")


def test_unregister_unknown_returns_none() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    assert manager.unregister("area.unknown") is None


# ----- Listing -----------------------------------------------------


def test_new_manager_is_empty() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    assert manager.areas() == ()
    assert manager.area_count() == 0


def test_areas_preserve_insertion_order() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    a = _area("area.left", Placement.LEFT)
    b = _area("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL)
    c = _area("area.right", Placement.RIGHT)
    manager.register(a)
    manager.register(b)
    manager.register(c)
    assert manager.areas() == (a, b, c)


def test_area_count() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    manager.register(_area("area.a"))
    manager.register(_area("area.b"))
    assert manager.area_count() == 2


# ----- Placement-aware helpers -------------------------------------


def test_count_by_placement() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    manager.register(_area("area.left", Placement.LEFT))
    manager.register(_area("area.central.a", Placement.CENTRAL))
    manager.register(_area("area.central.b", Placement.CENTRAL))
    manager.register(_area("area.right", Placement.RIGHT))

    assert manager.count_by_placement(Placement.LEFT) == 1
    assert manager.count_by_placement(Placement.CENTRAL) == 2
    assert manager.count_by_placement(Placement.RIGHT) == 1
    assert manager.count_by_placement(Placement.BOTTOM) == 0


def test_has_central() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    assert manager.has_central() is False
    manager.register(_area("area.central"))
    assert manager.has_central() is True


# ----- Clear -------------------------------------------------------


def test_clear_removes_all() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    manager.register(_area("area.a"))
    manager.register(_area("area.b"))
    manager.clear()
    assert manager.area_count() == 0
    assert manager.areas() == ()
    assert manager.has_central() is False


def test_clear_on_empty_is_noop() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    manager.clear()
    assert manager.area_count() == 0


# ----- Representation ----------------------------------------------


def test_repr_contains_ids() -> None:
    manager = AreaManager()
    manager.register(_area("area.central"))
    assert "area.central" in repr(manager)

"""Tests for Placement."""

from __future__ import annotations

from cranioz.ui.workspace.areas.placement import Placement


def test_placement_has_expected_members() -> None:
    expected = {"LEFT", "CENTRAL", "RIGHT", "BOTTOM"}
    actual = {member.name for member in Placement}
    assert actual == expected


def test_placement_values_are_lowercase() -> None:
    for member in Placement:
        assert member.value == member.name.lower()


def test_placement_can_be_looked_up_by_value() -> None:
    assert Placement("central") is Placement.CENTRAL
    assert Placement("left") is Placement.LEFT
    assert Placement("right") is Placement.RIGHT
    assert Placement("bottom") is Placement.BOTTOM


def test_declaration_order_is_not_significant() -> None:
    """Guards against code depending on the enum's declaration order."""
    # Sort by value, not declaration order. This test will keep passing
    # even if the order of members in Placement changes.
    by_value = sorted(Placement, key=lambda p: p.value)
    assert by_value == [
        Placement.BOTTOM,
        Placement.CENTRAL,
        Placement.LEFT,
        Placement.RIGHT,
    ]

"""Tests for LayoutTree."""

# mypy: ignore-errors
# This file exercises the structural layout tree with concrete Areas.

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from cranioz.ui.workspace.areas.area import Area
from cranioz.ui.workspace.areas.placement import Placement
from cranioz.ui.workspace.layout.layout_tree import (
    LayoutTree,
    LayoutTreeError,
    Leaf,
    Split,
)
from cranioz.ui.workspace.specs.area_spec import AreaSpec
from cranioz.ui.workspace.specs.editor_layout_spec import (
    EditorLayoutSpec,
    SplitDirection,
)

# ----- Helpers -----------------------------------------------------


def _area(
    area_id: str,
    placement: Placement = Placement.CENTRAL,
) -> Area:
    return Area(area_id=area_id, title=area_id, placement=placement)


def _spec(area_id: str, placement: Placement, editor_id: str) -> AreaSpec:
    return AreaSpec(
        area_id=area_id,
        title=area_id,
        placement=placement,
        editor_layout=EditorLayoutSpec.leaf(editor_id),
    )


def _areas_from_specs(specs: tuple[AreaSpec, ...]) -> dict[str, Area]:
    return {s.area_id: _area(s.area_id, s.placement) for s in specs}


# ----- Nodes -------------------------------------------------------


def test_leaf_holds_area() -> None:
    a = _area("area.central")
    leaf = Leaf(area=a)
    assert leaf.area is a


def test_split_requires_two_children() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(LayoutTreeError, match="at least two children"):
        Split(
            direction=SplitDirection.HORIZONTAL,
            children=(Leaf(area=_area("area.a")),),
        )


# ----- from_specs — single central --------------------------------


def test_from_specs_single_central_is_leaf() -> None:
    spec = _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.a")
    areas = _areas_from_specs((spec,))
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs((spec,), areas)
    assert isinstance(tree.root, Leaf)
    assert tree.root.area.area_id == "area.central"


# ----- from_specs — left + central + right ------------------------


def test_from_specs_left_central_right_is_horizontal_split() -> None:
    specs = (
        _spec("area.left", Placement.LEFT, "editor.left"),
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
        _spec("area.right", Placement.RIGHT, "editor.right"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    assert isinstance(tree.root, Split)
    assert tree.root.direction is SplitDirection.HORIZONTAL
    assert len(tree.root.children) == 3
    assert [leaf.area.area_id for leaf in tree.leaves()] == [
        "area.left",
        "area.central",
        "area.right",
    ]


def test_from_specs_central_only_with_two_is_horizontal() -> None:
    specs = (
        _spec("area.central.a", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.a"),
        _spec("area.central.b", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.b"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    assert isinstance(tree.root, Split)
    assert tree.root.direction is SplitDirection.HORIZONTAL


# ----- from_specs — with bottom ------------------------------------


def test_from_specs_with_bottom_is_vertical_split() -> None:
    specs = (
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
        _spec("area.bottom", Placement.BOTTOM, "editor.bottom"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    assert isinstance(tree.root, Split)
    assert tree.root.direction is SplitDirection.VERTICAL
    assert len(tree.root.children) == 2


def test_from_specs_four_areas_has_nested_split() -> None:
    specs = (
        _spec("area.left", Placement.LEFT, "editor.left"),
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
        _spec("area.right", Placement.RIGHT, "editor.right"),
        _spec("area.bottom", Placement.BOTTOM, "editor.bottom"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    assert isinstance(tree.root, Split)
    assert tree.root.direction is SplitDirection.VERTICAL
    top, bottom = tree.root.children
    assert isinstance(top, Split)
    assert top.direction is SplitDirection.HORIZONTAL
    assert isinstance(bottom, Leaf)


# ----- from_specs — errors ----------------------------------------


def test_from_specs_without_central_raises() -> None:
    specs = (
        _spec("area.left", Placement.LEFT, "editor.left"),
        _spec("area.right", Placement.RIGHT, "editor.right"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    with pytest.raises(LayoutTreeError, match="CENTRAL"):
        LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)


def test_from_specs_empty_raises() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(LayoutTreeError, match="at least one spec"):
        LayoutTree.from_specs((), {})


def test_from_specs_missing_area_raises() -> None:
    specs = (_spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),)
    with pytest.raises(LayoutTreeError, match="unknown area_id"):
        LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, {})


# ----- Traversal ---------------------------------------------------


def test_areas_returns_in_depth_first_order() -> None:
    specs = (
        _spec("area.left", Placement.LEFT, "editor.left"),
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
        _spec("area.right", Placement.RIGHT, "editor.right"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    assert [a.area_id for a in tree.areas()] == [
        "area.left",
        "area.central",
        "area.right",
    ]


def test_find_returns_leaf() -> None:
    specs = (
        _spec("area.left", Placement.LEFT, "editor.left"),
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    leaf = tree.find("area.central")
    assert leaf is not None
    assert leaf.area.area_id == "area.central"


def test_find_unknown_returns_none() -> None:
    specs = (_spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),)
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    assert tree.find("area.unknown") is None


def test_contains() -> None:
    specs = (_spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),)
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    assert tree.contains("area.central")
    assert not tree.contains("area.other")


def test_area_count() -> None:
    specs = (
        _spec("area.left", Placement.LEFT, "editor.left"),
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
        _spec("area.right", Placement.RIGHT, "editor.right"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    assert tree.area_count() == 3


# ----- Placement propagation ---------------------------------------


def test_leaves_carry_areas_with_correct_placement() -> None:
    specs = (
        _spec("area.left", Placement.LEFT, "editor.left"),
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
        _spec("area.right", Placement.RIGHT, "editor.right"),
        _spec("area.bottom", Placement.BOTTOM, "editor.bottom"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    by_id = {leaf.area.area_id: leaf.area.placement for leaf in tree.leaves()}
    assert by_id["area.left"] is Placement.LEFT
    assert by_id["area.central"] is Placement.CENTRAL
    assert by_id["area.right"] is Placement.RIGHT
    assert by_id["area.bottom"] is Placement.BOTTOM


# ----- find_regions -------------------------------------------------


def test_find_regions_single_central() -> None:
    specs = (_spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),)
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    regions = tree.find_regions()

    assert len(regions) == 1
    assert regions[0].region_id == "central"
    assert regions[0].semantic_role is Placement.CENTRAL
    assert [a.area_id for a in regions[0].areas] == ["area.central"]


def test_find_regions_left_central_right() -> None:
    specs = (
        _spec("area.left", Placement.LEFT, "editor.left"),
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
        _spec("area.right", Placement.RIGHT, "editor.right"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    regions = tree.find_regions()

    assert [r.region_id for r in regions] == ["left", "central", "right"]
    assert [r.semantic_role for r in regions] == [
        Placement.LEFT,
        Placement.CENTRAL,
        Placement.RIGHT,
    ]


def test_find_regions_returns_in_stable_order() -> None:
    """The order is LEFT, CENTRAL, RIGHT, BOTTOM regardless of spec order."""
    specs = (
        _spec("area.bottom", Placement.BOTTOM, "editor.bottom"),
        _spec("area.right", Placement.RIGHT, "editor.right"),
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
        _spec("area.left", Placement.LEFT, "editor.left"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    regions = tree.find_regions()

    assert [r.region_id for r in regions] == [
        "left",
        "central",
        "right",
        "bottom",
    ]


def test_find_regions_groups_multiple_central_areas() -> None:
    """A complex central region may contain more than one Area."""
    specs = (
        _spec("area.central.a", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.a"),
        _spec("area.central.b", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.b"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    regions = tree.find_regions()

    assert len(regions) == 1
    assert regions[0].region_id == "central"
    assert [a.area_id for a in regions[0].areas] == [
        "area.central.a",
        "area.central.b",
    ]


def test_find_regions_skips_placements_with_no_areas() -> None:
    """Only placements that have at least one Area produce a Region."""
    specs = (
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
        _spec("area.bottom", Placement.BOTTOM, "editor.bottom"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    regions = tree.find_regions()

    assert [r.region_id for r in regions] == ["central", "bottom"]
    # "left" and "right" do not appear because there is no Area there.


def test_find_regions_bounds_are_placeholders() -> None:
    """find_regions() does not compute geometry.

    Every returned Region has a placeholder Bounds (zero rectangle).
    The LayoutRenderer will fill the real Bounds once widgets exist.
    """
    specs = (
        _spec("area.left", Placement.LEFT, "editor.left"),
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    regions = tree.find_regions()

    for region in regions:
        assert region.bounds.is_placeholder() is True


def test_find_regions_every_area_belongs_to_exactly_one_region() -> None:
    specs = (
        _spec("area.left", Placement.LEFT, "editor.left"),
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
        _spec("area.right", Placement.RIGHT, "editor.right"),
        _spec("area.bottom", Placement.BOTTOM, "editor.bottom"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    regions = tree.find_regions()

    seen: list[str] = []
    for region in regions:
        seen.extend(a.area_id for a in region.areas)
    assert sorted(seen) == sorted(["area.left", "area.central", "area.right", "area.bottom"])
    assert len(seen) == len(set(seen))  # no duplicates


def test_find_regions_areas_are_in_depth_first_order() -> None:
    specs = (
        _spec("area.left.a", Placement.LEFT, "editor.a"),
        _spec("area.left.b", Placement.LEFT, "editor.b"),
        _spec("area.central", Placement.CENTRAL, "editor.central"),
    )
    areas = _areas_from_specs(specs)
    tree = LayoutTree.from_specs(specs, areas)

    regions = tree.find_regions()

    left = next(r for r in regions if r.region_id == "left")
    assert [a.area_id for a in left.areas] == [
        "area.left.a",
        "area.left.b",
    ]

FILE: tests/unit/ui/workspace/overlays/test_overlay.py

"""Tests for the Overlay ABC.

The Overlay ABC is an abstract interface. To exercise it we define
a concrete subclass, ``FakeOverlay``, that implements every abstract
method with the minimal behaviour required by the contract.

The FakeOverlay uses a real QWidget (a QLabel). The tests that
instantiate it use ``qtbot`` and therefore require a QApplication.
The tests that only inspect the abstract methods do not create a
widget and could in principle run without Qt; we keep them together
for clarity.

These tests verify:

- The ABC cannot be instantiated directly.
- A concrete subclass must implement every abstract method.
- overlay_id and target_region are readable.
- widget() returns the QWidget provided by the subclass.
- reposition() records the Bounds it receives.
- set_visible() / is_visible() work as expected.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QLabel, QWidget
from pytestqt.qtbot import QtBot

from cranioz.ui.workspace.areas.placement import Placement
from cranioz.ui.workspace.overlays.overlay import Overlay
from cranioz.ui.workspace.overlays.region import Bounds

# ----- Concrete test implementation ---------------------------------


class FakeOverlay(Overlay):
    """Minimal concrete Overlay used only in tests."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        overlay_id: str = "overlay.test",
        target_region: Placement = Placement.CENTRAL,
        widget: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._overlay_id = overlay_id
        self._target_region = target_region
        self._widget = widget if widget is not None else QLabel("Fake")
        self._visible = True
        self._last_bounds: Bounds | None = None

    @property
    def overlay_id(self) -> str:
        return self._overlay_id

    @property
    def target_region(self) -> Placement:
        return self._target_region

    def widget(self) -> QWidget:
        return self._widget

    def reposition(self, bounds: Bounds) -> None:
        self._last_bounds = bounds

    def set_visible(self, visible: bool) -> None:
        self._visible = visible
        self._widget.setVisible(visible)

    def is_visible(self) -> bool:
        return self._visible

    # ----- Test-only accessors ---------------------------------------

    @property
    def last_bounds(self) -> Bounds | None:
        return self._last_bounds


# ----- Abstractness -------------------------------------------------


def test_overlay_is_abstract() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        Overlay()  # type: ignore[abstract]


def test_concrete_overlay_can_be_instantiated(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    overlay = FakeOverlay()
    qtbot.addWidget(overlay.widget())
    assert isinstance(overlay, Overlay)


# ----- Identity -----------------------------------------------------


def test_overlay_id_is_readable(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    overlay = FakeOverlay(overlay_id="overlay.top_bar")
    qtbot.addWidget(overlay.widget())
    assert overlay.overlay_id == "overlay.top_bar"


def test_target_region_is_readable(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    overlay = FakeOverlay(target_region=Placement.CENTRAL)
    qtbot.addWidget(overlay.widget())
    assert overlay.target_region is Placement.CENTRAL


def test_target_region_accepts_all_placements(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    for placement in Placement:
        overlay = FakeOverlay(target_region=placement)
        qtbot.addWidget(overlay.widget())
        assert overlay.target_region is placement


# ----- Widget -------------------------------------------------------


def test_widget_returns_qwidget(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    overlay = FakeOverlay()
    widget = overlay.widget()
    qtbot.addWidget(widget)
    assert isinstance(widget, QWidget)


def test_widget_is_stable_across_calls(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    overlay = FakeOverlay()
    first = overlay.widget()
    second = overlay.widget()
    qtbot.addWidget(first)
    assert first is second


# ----- Reposition ---------------------------------------------------


def test_reposition_records_bounds(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    overlay = FakeOverlay()
    qtbot.addWidget(overlay.widget())

    bounds = Bounds(x=100.0, y=50.0, width=800.0, height=600.0)
    overlay.reposition(bounds)

    assert overlay.last_bounds == bounds


def test_reposition_accepts_placeholder_bounds(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    overlay = FakeOverlay()
    qtbot.addWidget(overlay.widget())

    overlay.reposition(Bounds())
    assert overlay.last_bounds is not None
    assert overlay.last_bounds.is_placeholder() is True


def test_reposition_can_be_called_multiple_times(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    overlay = FakeOverlay()
    qtbot.addWidget(overlay.widget())

    first = Bounds(x=0.0, y=0.0, width=100.0, height=100.0)
    second = Bounds(x=10.0, y=10.0, width=200.0, height=200.0)

    overlay.reposition(first)
    overlay.reposition(second)

    assert overlay.last_bounds == second


# ----- Visibility ---------------------------------------------------


def test_overlay_starts_visible(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    overlay = FakeOverlay()
    qtbot.addWidget(overlay.widget())
    assert overlay.is_visible() is True


def test_set_visible_false_hides_overlay(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    overlay = FakeOverlay()
    qtbot.addWidget(overlay.widget())

    overlay.set_visible(False)

    assert overlay.is_visible() is False
    assert overlay.widget().isVisible() is False


def test_set_visible_true_shows_overlay(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    overlay = FakeOverlay()
    qtbot.addWidget(overlay.widget())

    overlay.set_visible(False)
    overlay.set_visible(True)

    assert overlay.is_visible() is True


def test_visibility_toggle_does_not_destroy_widget(qtbot: QtBot) -> None:
    overlay = FakeOverlay()
    widget = overlay.widget()
    qtbot.addWidget(widget)

    overlay.set_visible(False)
    overlay.set_visible(True)

    # The widget instance is the same throughout.
    assert overlay.widget() is widget

"""Tests for OverlayManager.

The OverlayManager coordinates a set of Overlays: registration,
lookup, and repositioning when the layout changes. It does not
create Overlays and does not compute geometry.

These tests use a FakeOverlay: a concrete Overlay subclass that
records the Bounds it receives, so we can assert that
``reposition_all()`` routed the correct Bounds to the correct
Overlay.

The FakeOverlay uses a real QWidget (QLabel) because the Overlay
contract requires ``widget()`` to return a QWidget. The tests use
``qtbot`` and therefore a QApplication.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QLabel, QWidget
from pytestqt.qtbot import QtBot

from cranioz.ui.workspace.areas.area import Area
from cranioz.ui.workspace.areas.placement import Placement
from cranioz.ui.workspace.overlays.overlay import Overlay
from cranioz.ui.workspace.overlays.overlay_manager import (
    OverlayManager,
    OverlayManagerError,
)
from cranioz.ui.workspace.overlays.region import Bounds, Region

# ----- Test helpers -------------------------------------------------


class FakeOverlay(Overlay):
    """Minimal Overlay that records the last Bounds it received."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        overlay_id: str,
        target_region: Placement = Placement.CENTRAL,
        widget: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._overlay_id = overlay_id
        self._target_region = target_region
        self._widget = widget if widget is not None else QLabel(overlay_id)
        self._visible = True
        self._last_bounds: Bounds | None = None

    @property
    def overlay_id(self) -> str:
        return self._overlay_id

    @property
    def target_region(self) -> Placement:
        return self._target_region

    def widget(self) -> QWidget:
        return self._widget

    def reposition(self, bounds: Bounds) -> None:
        self._last_bounds = bounds

    def set_visible(self, visible: bool) -> None:
        self._visible = visible
        self._widget.setVisible(visible)

    def is_visible(self) -> bool:
        return self._visible

    @property
    def last_bounds(self) -> Bounds | None:
        return self._last_bounds


def _region(
    region_id: str,
    placement: Placement,
    bounds: Bounds | None = None,
) -> Region:
    """Build a Region with a single synthetic Area placeholder.

    The OverlayManager never inspects the Areas, only the
    ``semantic_role`` and ``bounds``. A synthetic Area is enough.
    """

    area = Area(area_id=f"area.{region_id}", title=region_id, placement=placement)
    return Region(
        region_id=region_id,
        bounds=bounds if bounds is not None else Bounds(),
        areas=(area,),
        semantic_role=placement,
    )


@pytest.fixture
def manager() -> OverlayManager:
    return OverlayManager()


@pytest.fixture
def make_overlay(qtbot: QtBot):
    """Factory to build FakeOverlay instances and register their widgets."""

    def _factory(
        overlay_id: str,
        target_region: Placement = Placement.CENTRAL,
    ) -> FakeOverlay:
        overlay = FakeOverlay(
            overlay_id=overlay_id,
            target_region=target_region,
        )
        qtbot.addWidget(overlay.widget())
        return overlay

    return _factory


# ----- Registration -------------------------------------------------


def test_new_manager_is_empty(manager: OverlayManager) -> None:
    assert manager.overlays() == ()
    assert manager.overlay_count() == 0


def test_register_adds_overlay(manager: OverlayManager, make_overlay) -> None:

    manager.register(overlay)

    assert manager.contains("overlay.top_bar")
    assert manager.overlay_count() == 1
    assert manager.get("overlay.top_bar") is overlay

    overlay = make_overlay("overlay.top_bar")
    manager.register(overlay)
    manager.register(overlay)
    assert manager.overlay_count() == 1

    b = make_overlay("overlay.top_bar")

        manager.register(b)


def test_register_empty_id_raises(manager: OverlayManager, qtbot: QtBot) -> None:

    overlay = make_overlay("overlay.a")

    assert manager.overlay_count() == 0
    assert manager.overlays() == ()
